result.summary: No critical visual breakage is apparent. The main concerns are abruptly clipped horizontal content and content appearing beneath the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category row ends with an unlabeled sliver of the next chip at the right edge, making it look accidentally cut off rather than clearly scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or expose enough of the next chip and its label to create a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you” is sharply clipped, including its restaurant name and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent partial-card preview with adequate right padding, or snap cards so text is not left partially visible at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the lower restaurant card, hiding part of its image and potentially subsequent details while scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation and safe-area height so all cards can scroll fully above the fixed bar.
